explication: Django is a Python web framework. A typical request enters the WSGI/ASGI handler, passes middleware, resolves URLs, executes application or built-in views, queries models through managers and QuerySets, and returns an HTTP response rendered by templates. The framework also supplies authentication, administration, sessions, static-file processing, caching, email, management commands, and pluggable database backends. The graph combines documented framework capabilities with sampled source; some application-specific view wiring is necessarily represented at the framework boundary.
